turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My old boots finally fell apart.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Time for new ones. Do you want proper leather boots with ankle support, or lighter trail shoes?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait for me, I need to talk to Emma about something. Don't say a word until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Emma, whose turn is it to take out the trash?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Pretty sure it's yours. I did it Tuesday and Thursday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Really? I thought I did Thursday.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: No, you were at your sister's on Thursday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh right. Fine, I'll take it down tonight.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Recycling too, please. The box is overflowing.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We were picking new hiking footwear, boots or trail shoes?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Boots. I twisted my ankle last year and I don't want that again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Makes sense. Break them in on short walks before any big hike.
